name: @myfiesta/door
description: What a door decides with no signal, where it keeps what it needs to decide, and the camera it reads tickets with. Shared by the console and the phone app.
_comment: Framework-free on purpose: plain TypeScript and browser APIs, compiled as source by whichever app imports it. Two apps admitting people through the same doors must not be two implementations of when to admit them. The one dependency is the ZXing ponyfill the camera reads with where the browser has no BarcodeDetector; each app that compiles this package lists it too, so either installs on its own.
